name: smart home automation network
script:
# Smart Home with Multiple Sensors & Actuators
temp_sensor = Sensor("temp_living")
motion_sensor = Sensor("motion_hall")
light_sensor = Sensor("light_outdoor")
arduino = Arduino("home_controller")
esp32 = ESP32("wifi_gateway")
rpi = RaspberryPi("central_hub")
led_lights = LED("living_lights")
fan = Actuator("ceiling_fan")
display = Display("status_panel")

# Sensor network to controller
temp_sensor.connect(arduino)
motion_sensor.connect(arduino)
light_sensor.connect(arduino)

# Controller to communication
arduino.connect(esp32)
esp32.connect(rpi)

# Hub to actuators
rpi.connect(led_lights)
rpi.connect(fan)
rpi.connect(display)

# Power system
arduino.turn_on()
esp32.turn_on()
rpi.turn_on()
led_lights.turn_on()
fan.turn_on()
display.turn_on()
